scripts.dev: npm run build -w @tag/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @tag/shared" "npm run dev -w @tag/server" "npm run dev -w @tag/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tag/shared && npm run build -w @tag/server && npm run build -w @tag/client && node scripts/compress.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tag/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:local: npm run build -w @tag/shared && npm run dev -w @tag/client
scripts.test:online: npm run build -w @tag/shared && npm run build -w @tag/server && node --test apps/server/test/*.test.mjs
